CreateAdvancedQueryHistory.description_en: Creates an advanced event query history record. You can save custom query conditional statements for reuse and management
CreateAdvancedQueryHistory.description_zh: 本接口用于创建高级查询历史记录，支持保存自定义查询条件语句以供复用和管理

CreateDeliveryHistoryJob.description_zh: 创建数据回补投递任务

CreateTrail.description_en: Creates a trail to deliver events to a destination for long-term storage and analysis, such as an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket, a Simple Log Service (SLS) Logstore, or a MaxCompute project
CreateTrail.description_zh: 操作审计默认为每个阿里云账号记录最近90天的事件。为了能够追溯90天以前的事件，您可以创建跟踪，将操作事件投递到对象存储OSS、日志服务SLS或大数据计算服务MaxCompute，以便对事件进行分析

DeleteAdvancedQueryHistory.description_zh: 本接口用于删除指定高级查询历史记录

DeleteDataEventSelector.description_en: Deletes the data event selector for a specified trail
DeleteDataEventSelector.description_zh: 本接口用于删除指定跟踪名称的数据事件选择器

DeleteDeliveryHistoryJob.description_zh: 删除数据回补投递任务

DescribeAdvancedQueryHistory.description_zh: 本接口用于获取所有高级查询历史记录

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the Alibaba Cloud regions that are supported by ActionTrail
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询操作审计支持的阿里云地域

DescribeResourceLifeCycleEvents.description_en: Queries the lifecycle events of a specified resource
DescribeResourceLifeCycleEvents.description_zh: 本接口用于查询指定资源的生命周期事件

DescribeScenes.description_zh: 本接口用于查询所有高级查询场景

DescribeSearchTemplates.description_en: Queries the advanced query system templates for a specified scenario
DescribeSearchTemplates.description_zh: 本接口用于查询指定场景下的高级查询系统模版

DescribeTrails.description_en: Queries the list of created trails
DescribeTrails.description_zh: 查看已创建的跟踪列表

DescribeUserAlertCount.description_en: Queries the number of daily alerts within a specific time range
DescribeUserAlertCount.description_zh: 查询用户时间段内每日告警量

DescribeUserLogCount.description_en: Queries the number of daily logs within a specific time range
DescribeUserLogCount.description_zh: 查询用户时间段内每日日志量

DescribeUserTrailCount.description_en: Queries the number of enabled trails, including organization trails
DescribeUserTrailCount.description_zh: 查询开启的跟踪个数，包含组织跟踪

DisableInsight.description_en: Disables a specific type of Insights event

GetAccessKeyLastUsedEvents.description_en: Queries the most recent events associated with a specified AccessKey pair, including the event name, source, timestamp, and details
GetAccessKeyLastUsedEvents.description_zh: 查询指定AccessKey的最后使用的事件记录

GetAccessKeyLastUsedInfo.description_en: Queries the most recent usage record of a specified AccessKey pair
GetAccessKeyLastUsedInfo.description_zh: 查询指定AccessKey的最后使用记录

GetAccessKeyLastUsedIps.description_en: Queries the IP addresses most recently used by a specified AccessKey pair
GetAccessKeyLastUsedIps.description_zh: 查询指定AccessKey的最后使用的IP记录

GetAccessKeyLastUsedProducts.description_en: Queries the Alibaba Cloud services most recently accessed by a specified AccessKey pair
GetAccessKeyLastUsedProducts.description_zh: 查询指定AccessKey的最后使用的云服务记录

GetAccessKeyLastUsedResources.description_en: Queries the resources most recently used by a specified AccessKey pair
GetAccessKeyLastUsedResources.description_zh: 查询指定AccessKey的最后使用的资源记录

GetAdvancedQueryTemplate.description_en: Retrieves information about a single advanced template
GetAdvancedQueryTemplate.description_zh: 获取单个高级模版信息

GetDataEventSelector.description_en: Retrieves the details of data event selectors for a specified trail
GetDataEventSelector.description_zh: 本接口用于获取指定跟踪名称的数据事件选择器详细信息

GetDeliveryHistoryJob.description_en: Queries the details of a historical event delivery task
GetDeliveryHistoryJob.description_zh: 查询数据回补投递任务详情

GetGlobalEventsStorageRegion.description_en: Queries the region where global events are stored
GetGlobalEventsStorageRegion.description_zh: 查询全局事件存储地域

GetGovernanceMetrics.description_en: Queries the governance metrics of ActionTrail
GetGovernanceMetrics.description_zh: 本接口用于查询操作审计成熟度

GetInsightSelectors.description_en: Queries the Insights event types to deliver for a trail

GetInsightTypes.description_en: Queries all enabled types of Insights events

GetInsightsEventsCount.description_en: Queries the number of Insights events for the current account
GetInsightsEventsCount.description_zh: 获取当前账号的Insights事件数量

GetTrailStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a trail

ListDataEventSelectors.description_zh: 本接口用于列举所有数据事件选择器

ListDataEventServices.description_en: Queries the services that support data events and the names of these events
ListDataEventServices.description_zh: 本接口用于查询数据事件支持的服务与事件名称

ListDeliveryHistoryJobs.description_en: Queries the list of historical event delivery tasks
ListDeliveryHistoryJobs.description_zh: 查询数据回补投递任务列表

PutDataEventSelector.description_en: Creates or configures a data event selector. A trail must exist before you create a data event selector. If a trail does not exist, you can call the CreateTrail operation to create one
PutDataEventSelector.description_zh: 本接口用于创建或设置数据事件选择器。请注意：如要使用本接口创建数据事件选择器，必须保证跟踪名称存在。如不存在，请先调用CreateTrail接口创建跟踪

PutInsightSelectors.description_en: Specifies the types of Insights events to deliver for a trail

StartLogging.description_en: Enables a trail to start delivering ActionTrail events to Object Storage Service (OSS), Simple Log Service (SLS), or MaxCompute
StartLogging.description_zh: 启用跟踪，开始将操作审计事件投递到 OSS 或 SLS 或 MaxCompute

StopLogging.description_en: Disables a trail to stop delivering ActionTrail events to Object Storage Service (OSS), Simple Log Service (SLS), or MaxCompute
StopLogging.description_zh: 停止跟踪，停止将操作审计事件投递到 OSS 或 SLS 或 MaxCompute

UpdateGlobalEventsStorageRegion.description_en: Specifies the region where you want to store global events
UpdateGlobalEventsStorageRegion.description_zh: 设置全局事件存储地域

UpdateTrail.description_en: Updates the configurations of a trail
UpdateTrail.description_zh: 调整操作审计跟踪的配置信息
